issue.title: Private attachment sidecar and shared store
issue.description: Bead note attachments of at most the git tier are stored in a private attachments-private sidecar, uploaded before the bead store is published, and fetched on demand with honest availability badges. A missing store or an explicit local-only choice keeps the bytes on this machine and says so.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/private_attachment_store.md requests this work

issue.title: Reserve the hidden private attachments-private sidecar
issue.description: sidecar_role: reserve the attachments-private sidecar role (repo <project>--attachments-private) as a hidden bare partial clone with default-private visibility, a default-no repo-init consent prompt, and a sase-side preflight test. Do not create GitHub repos or reserve the plain attachments name.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/private_attachment_store.md defines phase sidecar_role as one work unit

issue.title: Git blob store written with plumbing
issue.description: git_store: add GitAttachmentStore, a BlobStore over a bare partial clone that puts, checks, and fetches content-addressed objects with git plumbing, a writer lock, bounded fetch, and digest verification.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/private_attachment_store.md defines phase git_store as one work unit

issue.title: Placement, pre-publication upload, and outbox
issue.description: upload: place attachments with core policy and -L/--local-only, upload after the bead commit and before bead publication, and persist a durable outbox that attachment push and bead sync can drain.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/private_attachment_store.md defines phase upload as one work unit

issue.title: Lazy fetch, availability badges, and doctor
issue.description: fetch: lazily fetch under the auto-fetch cap for read, show, and path, render every availability badge, and add a sase doctor check for store reachability and outbox backlog.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/private_attachment_store.md defines phase fetch as one work unit
